SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition — "Available Interfaces for Your Selected Scope" (SAP_S4HANA_BEST_PRACTICES, version 2608)

https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD/<deliverable>/<topic>.html?version=2608.500 — the per-line-of-business "Communication Scenarios" topics; the exact page each name came from is in comm-scenario-name-sources.tsv

anonymous reads of help.sap.com's own published content service (http.svc/pagecontent, http.svc/deliverableMetadata, http.svc/elasticsearch). No login, no api.sap.com traffic, no DOM scraping of the Hub.

floor. 487 scenarios are those named in the 2608 "Available Interfaces for Your Selected Scope" table; 9 more come from the per-LoB Communication Scenarios topics. SAP publishes no single complete register of SAP_COM_* scenarios that this walk could read, and those topics state they list "the most important" scenarios, so the true total is higher and cannot be measured from these sources.
comm_scenario_id=Communication Scenario ID column of the Available Interfaces table, or the SAP_COM_ id printed on a Communication Scenarios topic

names were NOT recovered from per-scope-item Set-Up Instructions or from search snippets: in those pages the text beside a SAP_COM_ id is as often a scope item name, an interface name or a column label as it is the scenario name, and nothing published distinguishes them. only 62 of 496 of scenarios therefore carry a name.

comm_scenario_name=taken ONLY where SAP prints the name next to the id in structured markup (a table cell beside the id, or the exact form "Name (SAP_COM_xxxx)"). Names that could only be guessed from surrounding prose were NOT taken — the cell is empty instead.

api_ids=Interface ID column of the Available Interfaces table, pipe-joined, distinct, in table order. These are SAP's interface identifiers (OData/SOAP service names, RFC/BAPI names, IDoc types), not SAP Business Accelerator Hub externalIds; resolving them to Hub ids is a join aptus can make against api-hub-catalog.json and was NOT made here because it would be derived and this file has no link_source column.

direction, auth_methods, inbound_services and outbound_services are empty on every row: none of the sources read publishes them. SAP publishes them per scenario in the Communication Scenarios / Communication Arrangements apps inside a tenant, and per scope item in the Set-Up Instructions on SAP Signavio Process Navigator (login required). They are empty because SAP did not publish them here, not because the scenario lacks them.
an empty cell means the source did not publish the value. It never means none, and never means unknown-but-probably.
this file states what SAP publishes for release 2608. It says nothing about what any tenant has activated or arranged.
